quest.title: Seven-Star Selection
quest.description: As you stroll around Liyue, you bump into a familiar person...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x400, Mora x24100, Hero's Wit x3, Mystic Enhancement Ore x5

dialogues.speaker: Huixin
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME}, Paimon, it's been a long time.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, hey, Huixin! Long time no see!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Fancy meeting you here. How's work these days?

dialogues.speaker: Huixin
dialogues.text: Thanks to the help of people like you and colleagues like Ganyu, better all the time.

dialogues.speaker: Huixin
dialogues.text: But I've been feeling distracted at work lately. I just feel constantly agitated...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Has something happened?

dialogues.speaker: Huixin
dialogues.text: *sigh* It's a long story, but my father... He's thinking of stepping down from the Tianshu position due to health issues.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? What's wrong with Uncle Tian?

dialogues.speaker: Huixin
dialogues.text: Nothing, specifically... He's not unwell, he says he's just increasingly low on energy these days.

dialogues.speaker: Huixin
dialogues.text: He's always said, "Old age comes for us all in the end"... Still, I just can't help but feel a little emotional watching it happen to him.

dialogues.speaker: Huixin
dialogues.text: Anyway, my father's currently on the second floor of Yanshang Teahouse. Why don't you come pay him a visit with me?

dialogues.speaker: Huixin
dialogues.text: He seems very fond of you two. I'm sure chatting with you will make him very happy.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Sure! Let's go!

talks.objective: Go to the 2nd floor of Yanshang Teahouse

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Uncle Tian! We're here to chat with you!

dialogues.speaker: Uncle Tian
dialogues.text: Oh? Hah, what a lovely surprise. Welcome. Huixin, why don't you go downstairs and get the shopkeeper to make us a fresh pot of tea?

dialogues.speaker: Uncle Tian
dialogues.text: I heard that you've been traveling all over the place recently. I would very much like to hear your adventure stories.

choices.text: We're more concerned about your health, Uncle Tian.

response.speaker: Uncle Tian
response.text: Huixin told you, didn't she... Don't worry, I'm quite alright. It's just the years gradually catching up with me.

response.speaker: Uncle Tian
response.text: As I grow older, I'm starting to find that with many things, though the mind is willing, the flesh is weak. Especially recently, I've noticed a rather drastic drop in my energy levels.

response.speaker: Uncle Tian
response.text: I am still very much in good standing as the Tianshu today. Nevertheless, I wish to pass on the position before my mental acuity begins to decline beyond redemption.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: How difficult is it to transfer the Tianshu position?

response.speaker: Uncle Tian
response.text: Oh, well, you see, the Tianshu is a rather unique position among the Liyue Qixing.

response.speaker: Uncle Tian
response.text: Historically speaking, the Tianshu rarely appears in public. We stay behind the scenes, planning and giving advice. So a public selection process would not be suitable.

response.speaker: Uncle Tian
response.text: We also want to keep any prospective Tianshu candidates free from influence by outside forces, so we tend to be as discreet as possible in their assessment and appointment.

response.speaker: Uncle Tian
response.text: For these reasons, the incumbent Tianshu typically recommends their candidate of choice, and this is then approved by the other Qixing members.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: So in other words, you pick someone, and then Lady Keqing, Lady Ningguang, and the other Qixing appoint them?

response.speaker: Uncle Tian
response.text: Correct. Unfortunately, due to my health, I won't be able to assess every candidate myself.

response.speaker: Uncle Tian
response.text: Not to despair, however, because I've found someone exceptionally capable to act on my behalf as assessment officer. In fact, I believe you recently became acquainted with her yourself.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh? Who is it?

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: I'm heartbroken... I thought it might take you a little longer than this to forget all about me?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: It's Yelan!

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: Jackpot. Uncle Tian here asked me to assess three candidates for him.

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: #Fancy joining me, {NICKNAME}? You'll be among the first to get to know the next Tianshu. Might be a good opportunity for you.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Hmm... What do you think, {NICKNAME}?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon thinks so too! It can't be a bad thing to be on good terms with a new Qixing, right?

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: Alright then.

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: Though I gotta say, Uncle Tian, you say you're into behind-the-scenes planning? My work's of the covert variety, too... Don't you think I might make a good Tianshu?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh!? Yelan, you want to be the next Tianshu?

response.speaker: Uncle Tian
response.text: I'm not opposed to the idea, but I suspect Ningguang wouldn't let you go very easily after how long you've been working together.

response.speaker: Uncle Tian
response.text: So how about this... If your investigation reveals that none of the other candidates are qualified for the position, I'll recommend you for the job.

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: Deal. Well, you guys take your time. Everything's all set for the assessments to go ahead.

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: Meet me on the first floor when you're ready. Until then... have a pleasant conversation.

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: Oh — and no need to pay for your tea. As the new owner of this fine establishment, this round's on the house.

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: After telling Uncle Tian about your recent adventures, you return to the entrance of the teahouse...

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: You're all set?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Uncle Tian seems really worn down. It's like all his energy's gone...

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: Yeah. It may sound harsh, but Uncle Tian is past his prime. He's not cut out for this anymore.

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: So, he's recommended three candidates. Their names are: Qianwei, Mingbo, and Zhiyi.

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: Qianwei is a wealthy entrepreneur, Mingbo works at the Liyue Ministry of Civil Affairs, and Zhiyi is focused on study and travel.

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: Try to keep all that in mind... Of course, it doesn't really matter if you forget, since we'll be assessing them at Yuehai Pavilion in a short while.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Qianwei, Mingbo, Zhiyi... Paimon should be able to remember their names, but what does the assessment involve, exactly?

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: Let's leave that until we get to Yuehai Pavilion.

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: Alright. Heads in the game, people. The stakes don't get much higher than a change in the Qixing. We can't afford to miss anything, no matter how small.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Got it! {NICKNAME}, we'll keep our eyes wide open!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Makes sense. After all, whoever the next Tianshu is, it doesn't really make any difference to us.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Still, Paimon's really curious to see which candidates Uncle Tian picked! So let's go take a look!

talks.objective: Go to Yuehai Pavilion to perform your inspection

dialogues.text: My legs are getting sore... What is wrong with this assessment officer? This is a huge occasion, and I don't even get a chair.
I've dealt with all kinds of people in my time, but never have I been made to stand while I'm waiting for an appointment.
Oh, I mean... I—I think it's fine...
That's called being complacent. If you're happy to just accept the way things are, you'll never be able to change anything in the future.
Oh, come on, that's just... Now you're just... being unreasonable.
Alright, you two. Let's not get into a big argument over this. It's not worth it.
Qianwei, that was a bit uncalled for. And Mingbo, cut him some slack. We've all been standing around for a while. It's natural to be getting irritable.
Look, how about this: There's no rule saying we're obliged to stand up while we wait, so why don't we borrow some chairs from the guild nearby?

dialogues.speaker: Qianwei
dialogues.text: Fine. They're not the best quality chairs, to be sure, but under the circumstances, it would be better than nothing.

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: You enter the assessment venue with Yelan...

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: It looks like all three candidates have arrived.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Oh, it was those three?

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: Mm-hmm. We'll meet them formally soon. Before that, let me run you through the assessment process.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: I've split it into two stages: "Current Affairs and Planning" and "Face-to-Face Interview."

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: In the first stage, candidates are required to submit a manifesto for Liyue's development. In the second stage, we will ask them some questions in person.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: Writing a manifesto takes time, so I informed them of this requirement in advance. These are the reports they submitted.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wow, one of them is really thick...

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: It's also worth mentioning a stipulation I gave them: Whoever is appointed as the new Tianshu will be expected to implement their plan as put forward in their manifesto.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: Failing the occurrence of some cataclysmic event, they will not be permitted to change their plan. Therefore, these three piles of documents in front of us represent where each candidate stands on key policy issues.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: There is still some time. Have a skim through, get a first impression of what each person's proposing.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: I'll be waiting off to the side. Just let me know when you're done.

dialogues.speaker: Qianwei's Manifesto
dialogues.text: (Qianwei's manifesto addresses many commercial issues and provides some very penetrating analysis.)

dialogues.speaker: Qianwei's Manifesto
dialogues.text: (His view seems to be that "regulations and incentives are both indispensable.")

dialogues.speaker: Mingbo's Manifesto
dialogues.text: (Mingbo's manifesto covers domestic affairs quite comprehensively, focusing on people's livelihoods.)

dialogues.speaker: Mingbo's Manifesto
dialogues.text: (The core principle seems to be "The greater good means a world that works for everyone.")

dialogues.speaker: Zhiyi's Manifesto
dialogues.text: (Zhiyi's manifesto covers domestic affairs, foreign affairs, and checks and balances, all in great detail.)

dialogues.speaker: Zhiyi's Manifesto
dialogues.text: (The focus seems to be "problem-solving." It provides concise and clear solutions to various problems.)

dialogues.speaker: Zhiyi's Manifesto
dialogues.text: (It's so thick that you only have time to skim through it roughly...)

talks.objective: Check on the three people with Yelan

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: Finished, huh? What did you think?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Everyone took it very seriously...

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: Of course they did. They have the chance to be picked as the new Tianshu, so you can bet they're putting their best foot forward.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: And keep in mind, whoever gets in has to execute their plan as-written. Nobody wants to have any regrets.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What did you think, Yelan?

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: Hehe, that's for me to know and you to find out. We can talk more after the interviews.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: We'll see the candidates now. Let's do one at a time — start with Qianwei.

dialogues.speaker: Li'an
dialogues.text: Yes, Ma'am.

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: Li'an brings Qianwei in...

dialogues.speaker: Qianwei
dialogues.text: Oh? So you two are the assessment officers, are you?

dialogues.speaker: Qianwei
dialogues.text: I had assumed that given the great import of this situation, Lady Ningguang would perhaps be assessing us in person. I certainly hadn't imagined I'd be seeing two entirely unfamiliar faces.

dialogues.speaker: Qianwei
dialogues.text: I trust you've read through my manifesto? I'd be more than happy to clarify any details you found difficult to grasp — it was written with an expert audience in mind, after all.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Mind your tone, mister!

dialogues.speaker: Qianwei
dialogues.text: Relax, it wasn't intended as a personal slight against anyone in particular. I was simply stating a fact.

response.speaker: Qianwei
response.text: Cloud Retainer... you know this adeptus? Oh... Yes, I remember now. You must be the traveler that people are constantly talking about.

response.speaker: Qianwei
response.text: With your sterling reputation, you must have a respectable level of erudition. Perhaps you will be able to understand the concepts I have put forward... although I shouldn't get my hopes up.

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: After asking Qianwei some questions, Yelan tells him to fetch Mingbo.

response.speaker: Mingbo
response.text: Oh... is it my turn?

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: Yes. Please introduce yourself.

response.speaker: Mingbo
response.text: I'm, uh, Mingbo... I work in the Ministry of Civil Affairs.

response.speaker: Mingbo
response.text: I've worked there for, um, 9 years... 5 months... and 3 days. In that time, I've handled... 2,347 cases.

response.speaker: Mingbo
response.text: I have 12 active cases at the moment... They should be concluded in, uh... 16 days?

response.speaker: Mingbo
response.text: My current work is related to urban planning and I am also responsible for, uh, auditing the accounts. To be more precise, there are three parts to the accounts, namely...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Uh... Is it just Paimon, or is he not very good at public speaking?

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: You know what, let's leave the self-introduction there and move onto some questions.

response.speaker: Mingbo
response.text: Oh... Okay. Sorry...

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: Yelan forces her way through a few questions with Mingbo, then gets him to fetch Zhiyi.

response.speaker: Zhiyi
response.text: Hello. Hehe... Not gonna lie, I'm feeling a little nervous.

response.speaker: Zhiyi
response.text: What would you like to know? You're here to assess me, so ask away and I'll answer your questions to the best of my ability.

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: Your manifesto is very wide in its scope, but you don't seem to be personally involved in many of the specific fields. How can you be sure that you have the ability to put your plan into action?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: That was blunt...

response.speaker: Zhiyi
response.text: Very fair question — I completely understand where you're coming from.

response.speaker: Zhiyi
response.text: But I'm confident in my plan. I've visited many different places, talked to lots of people with far more expertise than myself, and my manifesto is the conclusion of these efforts.

response.speaker: Zhiyi
response.text: Of course, two different problems can be interconnected in very complicated ways, and you might reach two very contradictory conclusions depending on which one you're focusing on. What I've tried to do is strike a balance. In other words, present an optimal solution to all the problems as a whole.

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: How do you plan to determine whether you are right or wrong about your proposed solution being the optimal one?

response.speaker: Zhiyi
response.text: A great question! Well, I'd start by having my colleagues and the secretaries of the Yuehai Pavilion evaluate any proposals before implementation. Post-implementation, it would all come down to the results.

response.speaker: Zhiyi
response.text: If it turned out that my judgment was to blame for poor results, I would take responsibility.

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: Nice answer. Alright, next question...

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: After asking Zhiyi a few questions, Yelan sends him on his way.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: He seems like a great guy! Everything he said was thoughtful and logical and... he was just a pleasure to listen to!

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: Here's my take on what we just learned.

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: As you saw, Qianwei is highly knowledgeable. He proposes many excellent ideas in his manifesto which effectively target the big issues.

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: But he is very proud and incredibly stubborn. He doesn't care much about other people's feelings.

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: Mingbo's plan is more thorough and more measured. You can tell he's meticulous in his work, very detail-oriented.

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: But he and Qianwei are otherwise polar opposites. Mingbo is not very articulate and comes across as very timid in conversation.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Perfect summary, Paimon couldn't agree more! You're good at this, Yelan!

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: Last but not least, Zhiyi. His manifesto is full of pertinent details, his methodology is sound, and his proposals cover a broad range of fields, which is quite a rare feat.

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: The depth he goes into in each and every area means it can only be a product of painstaking work. Plus, he is modest and good at dealing with people.

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: But what really interests me is that many of his views happen to coincide with Uncle Tian's. Having someone like Zhiyi take the position would certainly put Uncle Tian's mind at rest.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Great!

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: We'll see. Let's go back and report to Uncle Tian.

choices.text: Did you learn them from Cloud Retainer?

talks.objective: Report the outcome of your inspection to Uncle Tian

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: You tell Uncle Tian about the assessment process.

dialogues.speaker: Uncle Tian
dialogues.text: *cough* ...I see. Then it's more or less as I anticipated.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: Alright, then let me ask this. The ideas in Zhiyi's manifesto are very similar to your own. Is there any particular reason behind this?

dialogues.speaker: Uncle Tian
dialogues.text: I didn't want to say anything when I gave you the list of candidates, for fear of affecting your judgment. But I can tell you now.

dialogues.speaker: Uncle Tian
dialogues.text: Those three candidates have all studied under me in the past. It's only natural that they share some similarities with me.

dialogues.speaker: Uncle Tian
dialogues.text: But Qianwei went on to focus on his business and Mingbo has always been occupied with his work at the Ministry of Civil Affairs. Of all of them, Zhiyi was with me for the longest duration.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoa! So how did you get to know them all, Uncle Tian?

dialogues.speaker: Uncle Tian
dialogues.text: Qianwei was referred to me by an old friend, Mingbo came to my attention in the course of my work. As for Zhiyi... Haha, that was pure happenstance.

dialogues.speaker: Uncle Tian
dialogues.text: We first met while fishing. Gradually, as we got to know each other, we started discussing all sorts of topics.

dialogues.speaker: Uncle Tian
dialogues.text: Zhiyi came from a poor family and his parents died when he was very young. But he was a gifted student and a fast learner.

dialogues.speaker: Uncle Tian
dialogues.text: He reminded me of a younger version of myself. So I started out giving him a few words of advice when we were out fishing, and noticed how quickly he caught on.

choices.text: Sounds like he's a friend to you.

response.speaker: Uncle Tian
response.text: Quite. And now, all of a sudden, he's grown into a mature young man. It's a joy to see, but it also gets one thinking.

response.speaker: Uncle Tian
response.text: The young are growing up, and I am growing old. How time flies... No one can escape the cycle of life.

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: I dunno, Uncle Tian, you still seem in pretty good shape to me. You might have another few years of work left in you, don't you think?

response.speaker: Uncle Tian
response.text: Oh, you! There's really no need to console me. Having less energy than I used to isn't such a bad thing. It just means I finally have a good reason to retire and spend my days doing what old men like me should be doing: going fishing whenever I feel like it.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Sounds like you sure love fishing, Uncle Tian!

response.speaker: Uncle Tian
response.text: There's nothing quite like fishing to pass the time. And freshly caught fish, ah, they make the most beautiful fish soup with barely any preparation required.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Fresh fish soup! Mmm, sounds tasty!

response.speaker: Uncle Tian
response.text: Doesn't it? Also, some time ago, Zhiyi purchased a very special recipe from an old fisherman.

response.speaker: Uncle Tian
response.text: When we've been fishing recently, Zhiyi always brings some extra ingredients he prepared in advance. The addition of these makes the soup taste even more wonderful.

response.speaker: Uncle Tian
response.text: That flavor makes for a fond memory... But at my age, who knows how many more chances I have left to taste it again.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Very many chances, I'm sure.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh, can Paimon come next time, too? Paimon really wants to try it!

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: Let's get back to the matter at hand. Uncle Tian, we've reported back, do you have a verdict?

response.speaker: Uncle Tian
response.text: Mm-hmm, I appointed you as the assessment officer, and I trust your judgment.

response.speaker: Uncle Tian
response.text: Had you not asked me why Zhiyi's ideas were so similar to mine, I was not going to mention my history with any of them.

response.speaker: Uncle Tian
response.text: This decision must be guided by what is fair and right. Please disregard all other considerations, and make your final decision only after a thorough review of each candidate's talents and capabilities.

response.speaker: Uncle Tian
response.text: Remember... you must be thorough.

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: Understood.

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: #C'mon, {NICKNAME} let's go talk somewhere else.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Bye-bye, Uncle Tian. Look after yourself!

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: You follow Yelan outside the teahouse...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: So... it's gonna be Zhiyi, right?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: His manifesto was written well, and he's the best speaker...

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: Easy, let's not rush. There's no time limit for this assessment.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh? So... are you gonna give them more tests or something?

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: No, nothing like that. The assessment itself is complete. But let me give you a word of advice: Things are not always as they appear.

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: The biggest no-no in intelligence work is to only get information from the person of interest themselves. The truth is almost always hidden beneath many layers of deception. You have to get information through many different channels.

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: For example... Wenyuan. Shanghua.

response.speaker: Wenyuan
response.text: Yes?

response.speaker: Shanghua
response.text: Lady Yelan, what are your orders?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ah! Who are they? Where did they come from?

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: Did they scare you? These two are Wenyuan and Shanghua. They work for me.

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: As my trusted assistants, they are always standing guard nearby. They also perform various assignments as required.

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: Shanghua is a business expert who gets his information by trading, Wenyuan relies on word of mouth, and there is also Wupei, who's not here right now...

response.speaker: Wenyuan
response.text: That meathead must've been out there on sea surveillance for some time now... Is he alright? I seem to remember that he can't swim.

response.speaker: Shanghua
response.text: Heh, nothing can take that guy down. Certainly not a little wind and waves.

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: Shanghua, visit all the commerce guilds and look into Qianwei's background. Wenyuan, go to the Ministry of Civil Affairs and look through Mingbo's work files.

response.speaker: Wenyuan & Shanghua
response.text: Yes, Ma'am!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Um, so what about Zhiyi?

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: Zhiyi? Well, obviously, as the most promising candidate, we will be investigating him ourselves.

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: Let's go to the docks first. Lots of people passing through there, you can find out all kinds of things.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: If we're looking for information, why don't we try talking to Bolai, the owner of Wanyou Boutique?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: He does business at the North Wharf. Maybe he'll have some news for us...

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: Hmm, that's actually not a bad idea. Let's go and ask him.

choices.text: Sounds like he's family to you.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: Finished?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Almost...

dialogues.speaker: Zhiyi
dialogues.text: By the way, do you have any idea who the assessment officer is this time?

dialogues.speaker: Mingbo
dialogues.text: Umm... I'm not sure...?

dialogues.speaker: Qianwei
dialogues.text: Me neither. They'd better get someone who knows what they're talking about, though. I don't want some amateur trying to decide my fate.

dialogues.speaker: Li'an
dialogues.text: Do you need a hand with anything?

dialogues.speaker: Li'an
dialogues.text: Huixin is taking some time off at the moment. I'm covering for her, just let me know if you need anything.

dialogues.speaker: Uncle Tian
dialogues.text: Oh, are the assessments complete?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Umm... Not just yet...
